name: Abraxas
description: Abraxas was a planet in the Abraxas system situated within the Yushan sector of the Mid Rim Territories. Abraxas was run dry of its rich natural resources by overwhelming mining, and became a base for the Eiattu pirates. Soon after the Battle of Endor, the New Republic discovered and threw the pirates out.
